A.claim: Unified: if 3 | gcd(x,y,z) or 4 | gcd(x,y,z), then A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions. Packages the 3|x,3|y,3|z family (FLT3) and the 4|x,4|y,z even family (not_fermat_42).

B.claim: Curvature stratification: |chi| < T is a FINITE set of Beal signatures precisely when T < 1/3 (since with x=y=3 the reciprocal sum is 2/3 + 1/z, bounded iff 1-T > 2/3). There are exactly 4 signatures with 1/12 <= |chi| < 1/6, 13 with |chi| < 1/4, and 29 with |chi| < 3/10, over reduced exponents with x <= y.
